npm.description: Wait as long as pnpm does before proposing an npm update: Renovate reads pnpm's minimumReleaseAge and minimumReleaseAgeExclude from pnpm-workspace.yaml (pnpm's default of 1 day when unset), and strict filtering opens no branch or PR until a release is old enough, listing it on the Dependency Dashboard meanwhile.

packageRules.description: eve and the Upstash AgentKit extension are a matched pair: the extension's _manifest.json declares the eve release it was built with and its distribution contract, and `eve build` fails when the installed eve is older than that release or does not support that contract. Group them so neither moves alone.
